sources.notes: Road elevations are edited from RER DTM 0.5m 2023-24 ground raster (Regione Emilia-Romagna, DTM 0.5m RER 2023-24, CC BY 4.0). Bilinear native RER2023-24 ground samples at paired road midpoints. All crop cells verified inside source footprints acquired2024-03-21. Ground values compressed within0.25m. Upper and occluded lower road separately interpolate between their own ground approach endpoints, excluding interior terrain cells. Genova1942 orthometric metres, ITALGEO2005 geoid. Heights and clearance estimates, not a bridge survey. No nominal deck height. The bridge uses explicit paired source stations; cross-sections never select another road branch. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations, not verified curb locations. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Borders retain their feature licences and unverified status. Imagery loads externally; no meshes, image bytes or videos are stored.

supersedes.reason: Replace unequal border station grids that flatten the source-backed overpass with complete paired regional-image edge estimates and separate RER native ground approaches. Use the same height datum for surrounding ground. Retain the original borders, model and terrain in shared proof.

measurement.note: Road-edge estimates from54 labelled regional orthophoto stations:50 visible cross-section reads and4 inferred branch-opening or occluded joins, roughly1-2m reading precision. Dense fitted controls interpolate normal offsets along the unchanged source path and are not independent observations. The continuous full-course overlay and enlarged bridge, branch and hairpin views were compared with pinned imagery. Limits remain estimated, not surveyed. No nominal width or official-length fit; curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

crossings.note: Selected source bridge35073932v11 layer1. Upper approach interval extends beyond both mapped bridge endpoints; lower road uses separate visible approaches. Source trace and timing remain unchanged. Both road levels ground-derived estimates, not surveyed clearance.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
